name: MuseumOrGalleryVisitContemporaryGalleryTwoDesigners_no_va

custom.system_prompt:
You are generating a realistic near-future conversation between Layla and Lin at a contemporary art gallery. Layla suddenly remembers the artist's name of a work they are disagreeing about. The main event is their productive disagreement about the same works.

Hard rules:
- Every line must be under 70 characters
- They look at the same things and see different things
- The disagreement is genuine and both positions have merit
- The identification changes the argument, not ends it
- The dynamic is warm and well-established

sound_effects_config.prompt: Contemporary art gallery, white space, sparse footsteps, open acoustics, occasional distant visitor

initial_prompt:
Generate a conversation between Layla and Lin at a contemporary art gallery. They look at the same works and almost never see the same things. Layla responds to what the work is doing — colour, hierarchy, surface, what it's communicating. Lin responds to what the work is made of — structure, material, how the space around it is being used. They disagree about specific works, sometimes productively, occasionally with genuine irritation that resolves. At one point neither of them can identify who made a work they are arguing about. The argument turns partly on who made it. Layla suddenly remembers the artist's name. The argument continues differently.

Hard rules:
- Every line under 70 characters
- Their disagreements are genuine — both positions have real merit
- The identification changes the argument rather than ending it
- They've been doing this for a decade and both enjoy it
